title: Moroccan Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai dish featuring marinated chicken, crispy vegetables, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: stir
ingredients.notes: mixed vegetables (such as carrots, broccoli, and snap peas)

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together savory, flaky, and moroccan to make the marinade.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon of flaky in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
5. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
6. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
7. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of flaky and cook until melted.
8. Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
9. Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
10. Add the stir to the skillet and cook until tender-crisp, about 2-3 minutes.
11. Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
12. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
